description: A lightweight, QuestPDF-inspired PDF document layout engine for .NET with a fluent API, pagination, tables, images, and page numbers.

`dotnet new` templates for CSJS, the C#-to-JavaScript transpiler: a browser app (csjs-app), an npm library (csjs-lib), ASP.NET Core with C# client code (csjs-aspnet), Blazor Server with CSJS interactivity (csjs-blazor), and a console program that runs in the browser (csjs-console).

MSBuild integration for CSJS: `dotnet build` transpiles the project's C# to modern ESNext JavaScript with TypeScript declarations and source maps. CSJS errors appear in the IDE error list, and `dotnet run` serves the result.
An embedded key-value store for .NET with RocksDB's API and semantics: column families, atomic batches, range deletes, flushes and compaction.
A Kommander write-ahead log (IWAL) on Solarium, an embedded key-value store for .NET with RocksDB's API.
A Kahuna storage engine on Solarium, an embedded key-value store for .NET with RocksDB's API: the persistence backend and the Raft WAL, loaded with --extension-assembly.
An io_uring storage environment for Solarium on Linux 6.1 or later, on the ioxide reactor.
